```
June 13 09:00 PT - X teaser (image)
June 15 11:05 PT - X launch thread (headline + 2 replies)
June 15 11:15 PT - LinkedIn company post
June 16 10:00 PT - X follow-up + clip
```

Hold publishes until assets + captions are live.

Tessa: Uploading assets to /marketing/assets/beacon. ETA tomorrow 5pm PT.
